nuggets.text: Jeff Choate coached Montana State from 2016 to 2019, reaching the FCS semifinals in his final season there.
Jeff Choate's first Wolf Pack season included a 42-37 win over Oregon State on the university's 150th birthday.
Dominic Kelley ran for 152 yards on 11 carries in the opener, including a 72-yard touchdown on the second snap.
Wolf Pack students set a record by claiming 5,049 tickets for the season opener against Western Kentucky.
The Wolf Pack popularized the Pistol offense under coach Chris Ault in 2004, and it has since reached the NFL.
In 1992, the Wolf Pack became the first team to win a conference title in its first Division I-A season.
The Wolf Pack knocked off No. 4 Boise State 34-31 in overtime in 2010.
The Wolf Pack were Big Sky Conference members from 1979 to 1992, sharing a league with Montana State.
Mackay Stadium is named for the Mackay family; Clarence Mackay funded the original stadium in 1909.
The Wolf Pack have two mascots, Alphie and Wolfie Jr.
